relationships.subject: SDH dynorphin-lineage interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: DYN neurons are also the main source of GABAergic synapses onto lamina I spinoparabrachial neurons throughout life

key_findings: Neonatal limited bedding stress (P2-P9) produced sex-dependent changes in spontaneous synaptic transmission onto adult SDH dynorphin neurons, increasing the E:I ratio in females only.

Early-life stress reduced primary afferent glutamate release probability (both sexes) and afferent-evoked excitatory drive onto female DYN neurons, without changing evoked inhibition or intrinsic excitability.
